racials.name: Perception
racials.desc: Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec.

racials.name: Will to Survive
racials.desc: Instantly removes all Stun effects.

racials.name: Ruthless
racials.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 2%.

racials.name: The Human Spirit
racials.desc: Spirit increased by 5%.

racials.name: Find Treasure
racials.desc: Allows the dwarf to sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap. Lasts until cancelled.

racials.name: Stoneform
racials.desc: Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.

racials.name: Big Game Hunter
racials.desc: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

racials.name: Earth Fury
racials.desc: Increases your critical strike bonus to damage and healing by 2%.

racials.name: Escape Artist
racials.desc: Instantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec.

racials.name: Eureka!
racials.desc: Your non-periodic damaging abilities have their Energy cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage for 8 sec. / Your non-periodic damaging abilities have their Mana cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage for 8 sec. / Your non-periodic damaging or healing abilities have their Mana cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage or healing for 8 sec. / Your damaging abilities have their Mana cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage for 8 sec. / Your non-periodic damaging abilities have their Rage cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage for 8 sec.

racials.name: Engineering Specialization
racials.desc: Your gnomish ingenuity reduces the rate of engineering devices failing or backfiring when you use them by 20%.

racials.name: Expansive Mind
racials.desc: Maximum Mana increased by 5%. / Maximum Energy increased by 5%. / Maximum Rage increased by 5%.

racials.name: Elune's Light
racials.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec.

racials.name: Shadowmeld
racials.desc: Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Using this ability in combat discourages enemies from attacking you, but increases the cooldown to 2 min.

racials.name: Quickness
racials.desc: Dodge chance increased by 1% and movement speed increased by 2%. Night Elf Rogues and Druids are harder to detect in Stealth as if they were 1 level higher.

racials.name: Wisp Spirit
racials.desc: Transform into a wisp upon death, increasing movement speed by 75%.

racials.name: Read Leyline
racials.desc: Attempt to tap into the power of a nearby leyline, increasing your Health and Mana regeneration by 100%. Lasts 30 sec if no leyline is nearby, and 15 min if one is found.

racials.name: Walk on Air
racials.desc: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

racials.name: Elemental Insight
racials.desc: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

racials.name: Wind Blessed
racials.desc: Increases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 3%.

racials.name: Blood Fury
racials.desc: Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.

racials.name: Shatter Curse
racials.desc: Instantly removes all Curses and Banes, and reduces all Magical damage taken by 5% for 8 sec.

racials.name: Hardiness
racials.desc: Duration of Stun effects on you reduced by 20%.

racials.name: Savage
racials.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and abilities by 1%.

racials.name: Berserking
racials.desc: Increases your casting and attack speed by 10% to 30%. At full health the speed increase is 10% with a greater effect up to 30% if you are badly hurt when you activate the ability. Lasts 10 sec.

racials.name: Rapid Regeneration
racials.desc: Regenerate 50% of your maximum Health over 6 sec. Any movement, action, or damage taken will cancel the effect.

racials.name: Beast Slaying
racials.desc: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

racials.name: Regeneration
racials.desc: Health regeneration rate increased by 20%. In addition, 20% of total Health regeneration will continue during combat.

racials.name: Cultivation
racials.desc: Cultivate a nearby herb, growing a duplicate you can harvest without requiring Herbalism skill. Each herb may only be cultivated once.

racials.name: War Stomp
racials.desc: Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 2 sec.

racials.name: Endurance
racials.desc: Total Health increased by 5% and critical strike bonus to damage and healing increased by 2%.

racials.name: Plainsrunning
racials.desc: Gain 1% increased movement speed every 5 sec spent moving, up to a maximum of 30% increase. Taking damage or standing still will reduce this effect. In addition, you move 3% faster while mounted.

racials.name: Cannibalize
racials.desc: When activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect.

racials.name: Will of the Forsaken
racials.desc: Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.

racials.name: Touch of the Grave
racials.desc: Your spells and attacks have a 20% chance to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health. / Your spells and attacks have a 30% chance to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health.

racials.name: Underwater Breathing
racials.desc: Underwater breath lasts 300% longer than normal.

racials.name: Skysight
racials.desc: Attempt to draw power from a convergence of elements and receive its blessing, increasing your movement and mounted movement speeds by 10%. Lasts 30 sec if no elemental convergence is nearby, and 15 min if one is found.

racials.name: Walk on Air
racials.desc: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

racials.name: Elemental Insight
racials.desc: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

racials.name: Wind Blessed
racials.desc: Increases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 3%.

milestones.title: Camping
milestones.text: Camping unlocks around level 5 through quests such as "The Great Outdoors". Build a campfire and let other players add tradeskill buffs to it.

milestones.title: Talent points
milestones.text: You get your first talent point at 10 and one more every level, 51 in total at 60.

milestones.title: Cozy Sleeping Bag hunt
milestones.text: A scavenger hunt in Westfall or the Barrens rewards the Cozy Sleeping Bag, which gives a stacking XP buff and lets you earn rested XP while logged out.

milestones.title: Legacy challenge
milestones.text: Reaching 25 completes a Legacy challenge. Legacy Points are earned account-wide and spent per character in the Legacy Trees.

milestones.title: Dual talent specialization
milestones.text: Buy Dual Spec from your class trainer for 10 gold, then swap between two specs freely outside combat.

milestones.title: Riding
milestones.text: Apprentice Riding is in the Forever client. Classic teaches it at 40; Forever hasn't confirmed its level yet.

milestones.title: Level cap
milestones.text: Forever stays at 60 for good. Launch raids (Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit, Onyxia's Lair) open on 9 December 2026.

milestones.title: Legacy challenge
milestones.text: Reaching 60 completes the last leveling Legacy challenge.
